How The Room Where It Happens connects

  • Character: Aaron Burr — Burr sings The Room Where It Happens from outside the bargain.
  • Work: Hamilton (musical) — The Room Where It Happens is Burr's second-act showpiece.

What is The Room Where It Happens?

The Room Where It Happens is Aaron Burr's second-act showpiece: the dinner at which Hamilton, Jefferson, and Madison trade the capital for assumption, and Burr is left outside the door.

Key threads lead to Aaron Burr and Hamilton (musical).
